revisions.note:
REPAIR PASS (revision 4). Append-only; revisions 2 and 3 are preserved untouched.

(1) RESTORED the two evidence entries this briQ's own Evidence line requires and that revision 3 dropped: the
'bash -n ... shellcheck: no findings (rc=0)' entry and the '--dry-run --seconds 3 ... CAPTURE_GATE=FAIL, VERDICT=NEEDS_OWNER_TEST'
entry. Both now exist only in revision 2, so the effective record (WORK-QUEUE.md section 1: 'the effective record is always the last
revision') no longer carried them and the rendered evidence count for this task fell 5 -> 4. Revision 3 was written as a fresh
snapshot instead of a deep-copy+append, so the removal was not deliberate and its note does not claim it was. I re-ran both in this
repair pass: 'bash -n' + shellcheck are clean (rc=0), and the dry run terminates bounded with rc=1, CAPTURE_GATE=FAIL,
VERDICT=NEEDS_OWNER_TEST. Both entries are restored through the tool's own append path. Note on the count: because revision 3 is
append-only history it also ADDED one entry revision 2 did not have (the live-capture-pre-rename-records/README.md audit record), so
the honest effective count is 7, not 5 - every revision-2 entry is present again and nothing was removed to get there.

(2) CORRECTED the bad path cited by revision 3's intended_changes[1], which pointed at
'docs/beta-finalization/reports/BETA-MANUAL-PROOF-CHECKLIST.md'. There is NO reports/ directory anywhere in the tree (the only
occurrence of the string 'beta-finalization/reports/' in docs/ or tools/ was revision 3 itself). The area-1 (touchscreen) re-stamp
was actually made in docs/beta-finalization/BETA-MANUAL-PROOF-CHECKLIST.md, which really does carry the re-stamped counts
(240 PASS, self-test 43/43, 27-file eventN gate). A resumption tool following the record's paths would have looked in the wrong
place. No reports/ consolidation is planned for bg-12: the checklist stays where it is, and the erroneous string lives on only in
revision 3's frozen history plus the copy the deep-copy carried into this revision's list, which the correction entry appended here
names explicitly. Revision 3 is not rewritten.

(3) Also recorded here: the owner-facing one-line Linux note the sibling console-channel repair required (both footpaths of the bare
nuxel-live.sh form now say Linux hosts must pass --dev until the glob-safe discovery revision is in the tree).

The harness and the finger test are UNCHANGED and still terminate at NEEDS_OWNER_TEST: no finger has touched the glass, the device
is still in charger/LPM mode on this boot, and nothing here is promoted to VERIFIED_ON_S10PLUS.
